_about: Roadmap progress. Each phase is a weighted list of items; weight is the item's share of that phase's effort, done its completion from 0 to 1. kind 'measured' means tools/progress.py computes done from the repository (or a census figure it records here); 'estimate' means a judgement, with its evidence. See docs/progress.md.

P1.item: Translation, lockstep, routes and the emulated PC (roadmap Phase 1 'Done')
P1.evidence: All 17 code files translated (89,276 instructions); instruction lockstep 0 mismatches over 5.7M states; 27 routes identical across engines; fidelity.py 1,210/1,210; housekeeping done.

Settled by scope 8 Oct 2026 (roadmap 'Settled'): the weight is cut to the work done, dropping what was left. What was left (the test pilot's 7 of 9 over a +-15% stick-scale range on 86Box) measures the pilot, not the machines. Before: Done: tools/pc_parity.py checks pictures, music and the saved roster on both against measured limits, fidelity_all.py holds the machine probe, 86Box runs are deterministic (8 Oct 2026: the harness hook in the emulation thread; repeat runs byte-identical), the closed-loop supply drop delivers on both, a closed-loop career sortie saves its roster on both (DOSBox-X's and 86Box's byte-identical, ours differing only in the mission score, which END scores the same from either machine's handover), the 86Box intro drift and pitch-bend writes are explained, and the decision to use them as the routine references is made. The 86Box adaptor sends the stick as whole game frames (the game runs at about half the frame rate there), and the supply drop, the strike-training hit and the career landing then pass on 86Box too. Open: those flights pass 7 of 9 over a +-15% range of the one estimated stick scale, so a mission with a narrow window can still miss on 86Box.

P1.item: The picture against the references, frame by frame
P1.evidence: Settled by scope 8 Oct 2026 (roadmap 'Settled'): the weight is cut to the work done, dropping what was left. What was left (one-sample DOSBox transitions whose frame follows the capture's phase) describes the capture; frame timing against a period PC moves to the 386 profile. Before: The SVGA_S3 screen-off fix removes five false black local pictures. DOSBox 0.74 source confirms fractional PIC scheduling from pixel clock/CRTC totals; local frame, line-part, retrace, status and I/O slice deadlines now use rational event times with whole-instruction ceiling boundaries. After the pc_slice_left refinement, saved independent capture intro-qlh_wi26 matches 1,329/1,332 exact pictures, with three one-sample logo images unmatched on each side and -0.000034 ms end drift. Fresh capture intro-cfku0zec matches 1,321/1,332, with 11 one-sample images unmatched on each side and +14.268 ms drift. The local 1,332-picture sequences are identical; remaining transition differences depend on reference capture phase. No multi-sample mismatch remains; exact frame parity is open. 86Box (386DX/33): 86 of 87 graphics pictures exact in 6-bit DAC values, in order, the other a single mid-draw sample (pc_parity.py requires 84); its timing is a different machine's by design, so frame timing is judged against DOSBox.

Settled by scope 8 Oct 2026 (roadmap 'Settled'): the weight is cut to the work done, dropping what was left. What was left (an independent GOG DOSBox cargo delivery, wider generated-assignment coverage) tests reference emulators and pilots; all eight objective types have gate routes. Before: Strike and strike-return inputs have been refreshed after rational VGA slice-boundary timing and pass paired strong observers under both engines with byte-identical input, flight and result files (return clock 15029717426/hash 7b49aac1f746ffa7, result 0/status 3); both routes also pass the official world, VGAME-exit and END-debrief gates. Recon primary and return are likewise refreshed and paired. A recomp trap-poll fix (nested guest_call returns) was needed for long observer runs; the full gate passes with it (27/27 routes identical, both locksteps 0 mismatching). Independent GOG DOSBox supply-mission generation is reproduced (exact type-3/target-24/departure-58/home-51 triple at a -275 ms seed compensating autoexec overhead); open-loop replay then diverges in flight. A closed-loop pilot (cargo_pilot.py) delivers on our machine and the same pilot delivers on DOSBox-X (7 Oct: one timely impact in the delivery area, no credit, on both; DOSBox-X given the Machine's START seed tick and wall clock). Air-to-air types 5-8 were re-recorded under the current timing and are gate routes (airair_type5-8), each replaying byte-identically under both engines with result 0/status 3; all eight primary objective types now have gate-replayed normal-input routes. Wider generated-assignment coverage remains open. D7 settled (7 Oct): the Ground Strike Training mission is reproducible and credited with a release inside the laser-guided bomb's narrow window (80-150 map units); the report follows from D8's clamp.

Settled by scope 8 Oct 2026 (roadmap 'Settled'): the weight is cut to the work done, dropping what was left. What was left describes DOSBox, not the original; the 386DX/33 profile supersedes it. Before: PIT control-word IRQ found and fixed; I/O slice suppression matched; the retrace-phase note settled (7 Oct): started 275 ms in, as GOG's DOSBox is, all 22,840 AdLib writes over 106 s are identical to its capture; PLAYER's few-byte DAC gap and the BIOS/DOS stub timing open. The 386-against-286 flag bits 12-14 are never read by the translated code (all 14 real PUSHF sites verified as save/restore pairs).

P1.item: Rendered sound: speech and the PC speaker
P1.evidence: Scope 8 Oct 2026: matching DOSBox's OPL mixer sample for sample is dropped (the synthesis is the emulator's, the register stream the game's, and that is exact): every AdLib write of the intro matches GOG's capture in order and value (7 Oct). Speaker, shown 8 Oct 2026: the host runs PIT counter 2 clock by clock to the 8254 data sheet (src/host/speaker.c); the speaker driver's music, whose count rewrites the old renderer took at once (restarting the wave), now matches DOSBox-X's capture (tools/speaker_parity.py, intro 138 s: envelope 0.87, spectral 0.92-0.93, level 0.95; before 0.69, 0.54, 0.47), with its 736 gate changes and 440 control words identical; the radio call (counter 2 mode 0 PWM, 79-clock carrier) has its 12,924 counts identical to DOSBox-X's and renders carrier-free (realsound, default) or as the pulse train (pwm); in band it equals GOG DOSBox's count-as-level model (|r| 0.97, equal energy). Open (weight 0.7 of 5.6): an audio reference for the speech (DOSBox-X plays none of it), speaker timing against 86Box, the AdLib speech's in-flight writes against a reference; listening is Phase 4.

Shown 8 Oct 2026: both engines charge the same 386DX/33 profile; all 93 probe blocks match the saved MS-DOS 5.00/MOUSE.COM 6.26 reference (AH=2Ch varies by four cycles between runs); 5,713,152 instruction comparisons under the profile, repeated with code in VRAM at a second seed, have zero differences including prefetch and held REP state. Paired flight sessions have all 574 memory/register/output/scanout checkpoints and stick responses identical. STI and SS-load shadows are mapped to cycle retirement, including a following zero-cycle instruction (four regressions fail before and pass after). Matched entries run the original translated body under the profile. Earlier reference work showed the intro animation holds 86Box's pace to a frame. Open: file loading (+1.48 s of drift in the loads, against a RAM-disk-speed disk model); direct cycle charges in handwritten matched routines are a later speed improvement.

P3.item: Stage 0: measure what draws, and an observer that logs the drawing primitives per frame
P3.evidence: Measured and written up (docs/presentation.md) and the observer is built: hooks on game_draw, the matched projection, VGAME's fill and outline paths and every graphics library entry (lines, span fills, blits decoded; the rest logged with their page changes), f117run --observe, hashes unchanged with it on, ROM-free unit test. Not yet: a vertex observer on the original's own (non-matched) projection path.

P3.item: Stage 1: draw lists replayed bit-exact at 320x200
P3.evidence: Whole phases rebuilt byte for byte over the 64 KB work page and the A000 display page (tools/drawlist_frame.py): 73 of 73 phases on 30M instructions of the strike flight, and every phase of 30M-instruction windows of four more routes (recon 34, Central Europe air-to-air 29, landing 38, cargo 38), with no byte copied from the original on any of them. Work-page changes replay by rule; direct display writes from uncoded graphics entries are replayed from captured byte deltas. Entry 22 (the scaled RLE sprite) is decoded and replayed, which closed the two late-flight windows that had copied bytes. The remaining work is unexercised branches (dithered fills, the sprite clip edge cases) and windows not yet captured.

Shown 8 Oct 2026 (tools/hires_subpixel.py, docs/presentation.md): the model polygons re-projected from the logged camera-space vertices and filled with a tiling rule; equal to Stage 1 at N=1 in five windows (strike, recon, landing, two air-to-air); at N=2 and 4 flat-pixel agreement 99.96-100% and the fine picture 1.5-5.4 times the nearest-neighbour floor's change. Open: text, sprites, the HUD and the cockpit art (still scaled copies), 3-6% of polygons (near-clipped, horizon slivers), the live path.

P3.item: Stage 3 and 4: interpolation to 60+ fps, pacing and polish
P3.evidence: Stage 3 studied 8 Oct 2026 (tools/interp_frame.py): at 320x200 the replay is exact at both logic frames in seven windows, 86-98% of model polygons pair between steps, 1 of 182 flight steps was a cut held, no in-between primitive is absent from both neighbours; the 320x200 in-between frames change under 1% of pixels, so the payoff needs Stage 2's fine grid. Open: the live path (the machine hands the host each step's records; the host pairs two steps and draws against the mission clock), Stage 4 (pacing, vsync, a switch to the original picture, HUD handling).
